query: The Church of the Guanche People was founded in the city that is on the most populated island of what larger area?

pipeline_result.response:
The Church of the Guanche People was founded in Cártica, which is located on the island of Tenerife, part of the Canary Islands. The larger area referred to here is the Canary Islands, an archipelago situated off the northwest coast of Africa.

To answer your question more precisely: The Church of the Guanche People was established in Cártica, a town on the eastern side of La Palma, one of the Canary Islands. Tenerife, the largest island within this archipelago, is located in the Atlantic Ocean and is part of Spain. Therefore, the larger area where the Church of the Guanche People was founded is the Canary Islands.
